text_to_image_prompt: Use case: product-mockup. One complete styled outfit, photorealistic product catalog image, portrait 2:3, pure white seamless background, soft studio light. Invisible hollow clothing with no person, body, skin or visible mannequin. Clothing: Fitted black off-shoulder long-sleeve top with narrow charcoal trim and cuffs, extra wide faded gray panel-seam jeans, chunky black platform shoes.  Accessories: One long black silk tie with narrow diagonal charcoal silver stripes, loosely knotted. ; One integrated layered silver necklace with two chains and a small simple cross pendant, displayed as one accessory. ; One slender dark charcoal and black leopard-pattern fabric shoulder bag with a long strap. ; One black leather belt with a dark antiqued silver heart-shaped buckle, softly coiled. ; One silver double-drape trouser chain with small metal clip ends, no other objects.  All attachable accessories worn naturally on the ensemble at realistic scale. Unattachable tiny accessories arranged adjacent to the ensemble. Full uncropped framing, no text, logos or watermark.
original_prompt: Use case: compositing. Create one complete styled outfit catalog image for a wardrobe library. Image 1 is the existing clothing ensemble to preserve; image 2 is a supporting contact sheet of the exact accessory products to incorporate (layout and small captions are reference-only; do NOT reproduce them). Preserve the clothing shapes, colors, fabrics, cut, shoes and natural drape of image 1. Add all listed accessories, scaled realistically: tie at collar or hip per notes, bag suspended from shoulder, belt threaded at waist, chains or charms attached to waist or bag, necklace draped naturally at neckline. This is one fully coordinated dressed ensemble, NOT a board of separately enlarged products. Keep tiny unattached items (earrings, rings, eyewear, hat, lipstick) in a small neatly spaced cluster beside the shoulder or hem only when they cannot be shown attached without inventing a body. Pure white opaque seamless background, soft studio light, minimal contact shadow, photoreal fabric and materials. Portrait 2:3, full ensemble uncropped with clear margin. ABSOLUTELY NO person, body, skin, face, head, neck, hands, legs, mannequin, hanger or stand. Empty hollow clothes; white visible through lace and empty space between separate garments. No labels, typography, logos, brand marks, watermark or frame. Never add extra garments or shoes not listed. Clothing: Fitted black off-shoulder long-sleeve top with narrow charcoal trim and cuffs, extra wide faded gray panel-seam jeans, chunky black platform shoes.  Accessories: One long black silk tie with narrow diagonal charcoal silver stripes, loosely knotted. ; One integrated layered silver necklace with two chains and a small simple cross pendant, displayed as one accessory. ; One slender dark charcoal and black leopard-pattern fabric shoulder bag with a long strap. ; One black leather belt with a dark antiqued silver heart-shaped buckle, softly coiled. ; One silver double-drape trouser chain with small metal clip ends, no other objects.  Placement notes: Striped tie drapes as neck scarf without a visible neck. Only incorporate accessory types explicitly listed for this outfit; do not invent a belt, necklace or additional object. Clothing silhouette must remain identical to input 1.
